programs.title: Babygirl
programs.desc: Romy (Nicole Kidman) leads a stable and prosperous life.She manages a modern, dynamically developing company, lives in a comfortable house with her devoted husband Jacob (Antonio Banderas) and two teenage daughters.Her everyday life changes when a young intern, Samuel (Harris Dickinson), appears.Despite the age difference, Romy and Samuel begin a fiery romance.The woman begins to rediscover herself, although this decision may mean the loss of both her professional position and her family.She is faced with the decision of whether to follow her own desires, risking everything she has achieved so far.

programs.title: Murder In Glitterball City
programs.desc: Behind the scenes of the crime that took place in 2010 in Louisville, Kentucky.In the basement of the home of Jeffrey Mundt and his boyfriend, Joseph Banis, police found the mutilated body of James Carroll.

programs.title: One, two, three... You're in the game
programs.desc: Salem, Massachusetts, a town marked by a history of witch hunts.Jonah (Benjamin Evan Ainsworth) and his older brother Marcus (Asa Butterfield) come across an abandoned cabin while biking through the forest.They find a diary and a knife with a mysterious inscription on its blade.When read to her, it evokes a demon that forces young people to participate in macabre versions of children's games - from hide and seek to tag.The brothers, their sister Billy (Natalia Dyer) and her friends take part in the bloody showdown.They discover that this competition from hell cannot be won.

programs.title: Happy Feet Two
programs.desc: Mambo is the most popular tap dancing penguin in Antarctica and he is madly in love with the beautiful Gloria.The fruit of their love is the smart and resolute Eric.The boy, like his father once, tries to find his place in the world.However, it turns out that he does not share his parent's passion - he cannot and does not want to dance.Soon the little rebel meets the charismatic Sven, who can fly.Obsessed with his new idol, he distances himself more and more from his father.Meanwhile, the entire penguin population begins to face great danger.Mambo, with the help of his faithful friends Ramon and Lovelas, decides to fight to restore the old order in a frosty land... A continuation of the Oscar-winning animation about the adventures of an extraordinary penguin.In the Polish language version, the characters were voiced by, among others: Bartosz Obuchowicz, Sonia Bohosiewicz, Cezary Pazura, Tomasz Kot and Wojciech Mecwaldowski.

programs.title: In short
programs.desc: The year 2019, on the threshold of the pandemic.Single woman Ellen (Laura Tonke) spends New Year's Eve with her friends.No one knows that she is having an affair with Sebastian (Ronald Zehrfeld), Eva's (Antje Traue) husband.Rolf (Nicholas Ofczarek) and Dina (Pegah Ferydoni) make a perfect couple, unlike Mareike (Annette Frier) and Adam (Trystan Pütter).Maya (Katia Fellin) wants children, Natalie (Jasmin Shakeri) cannot decide.Max (Henning Flüsloh) comes into Ellen's life and he would love her if she let him.Years pass.The woman attends various types of celebrations, birthday parties and casual social gatherings.He learns about events in his friends' lives.The sense of community unites and allows everyone to return to everyday life with positive energy.Remake of the Danish film "A Long Story Briefly".

programs.title: Noah: Chosen by God
programs.desc: The distant past.Due to the wickedness of Cain's descendants, the inhabitants of large cities, the world is falling into decline.Only representatives of the House of Set still carry out the will of the Creator.One night, former warrior and healer Noah (Russell Crowe) has a terrible dream.He sees it as a gigantic flood that destroys the world.Along with his wife Naameh (Jennifer Connelly) and three sons, he visits his grandfather Methuselah (Anthony Hopkins) to seek his advice.He discovers that his dream is actually a prediction of the great flood.Noah becomes aware that he has been chosen by the Creator to save the lives of innocents.With the help of stone giants called Guardians, he begins work on an ark that will be a shelter for various animal species.Years later, when the specter of disaster becomes more and more real, the huge ship is almost ready.Then the descendant of the first murderer, the self-proclaimed ruler Tubal-kain (Ray Winstone), demands a place in the ark for himself and his subjects.
